sources.entry: Lidarr - Music collection manager for Usenet and BitTorrent users. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 C#/Docker

summary.one_liner: Lidarr is a music collection manager for Usenet and BitTorrent users that monitors feeds for new tracks, downloads and renames them, and can upgrade existing files to better quality.
summary.what_it_does: Lidarr monitors multiple RSS feeds for new tracks from favorite artists and grabs, sorts, and renames them. It can scan an existing library and download missing tracks. It can watch for better-quality versions of tracks already owned and upgrade them automatically. Failed downloads are handled by trying another release, and manual search lets you pick any release or see why one was not grabbed automatically. Track renaming is fully configurable, and the README names integrations with SABnzbd, NZBGet, Kodi, and Plex. It also says it supports specials and multi-album releases.
use_cases: automatically download new releases from favorite artists
organize and rename a music library
fill in missing tracks in an existing collection
upgrade music files to higher quality
automate Usenet or BitTorrent music downloads
update Plex or Kodi music libraries after downloads
notable: Watches RSS feeds for new tracks and upgrades existing files when better quality appears
Integrates with SABnzbd and NZBGet for Usenet downloads
Notifies and updates Kodi and Plex libraries and metadata
Fully configurable track renaming and manual release search
caveats: README notes the Lidarr Metadata Server is recovering and rebuilding its cache, which affects adding artists and library imports
GitHub Issues are reserved for bugs and feature requests only
